00001| # tmpltr - AI Agent Guide
00002| 
00003| tmpltr compiles TOML content files into PDFs using Typst templates, with support for brand management (logos, fonts, colors).
00004| 
00005| ## Core Concept
00006| 
00007| ```
00008| [Content File .toml] + [Template .typ] + [Brand (optional)] --> tmpltr compile --> [Output .pdf]
00009| ```
00010| 
00011| The content file contains structured data and text blocks. The template defines layout and styling. Brands provide reusable visual identity assets. tmpltr merges them via Typst.
00012| 
00013| ## Quick Start
00014| 
00015| ```bash
00016| # Compile content to PDF
00017| tmpltr compile content.toml -o output.pdf
00018| 
00019| # Compile with a specific brand
00020| tmpltr compile content.toml --brand byteowlz -o output.pdf
00021| ```
00022| 
00023| ## Content File Structure (.toml)
00024| 
00025| ```toml
00026| [meta]
00027| template = "my-template.typ"  # Path relative to content file location
00028| template_id = "my-template"
00029| template_version = "1.0.0"
00030| 
00031| # Brand settings (optional, can be overridden with --brand flag)
00032| [brand]
00033| logo = "path/to/logo.svg"
00034| 
00035| [brand.colors]
00036| primary = "#0f172a"
00037| accent = "#38bdf8"
00038| 
00039| # Structured data - access as data.quote.* in template
00040| [quote]
00041| number = "Q-2025-001"
00042| title = "Project Title"
00043| date = "2025-12-09"
00044| 
00045| [quote.client]
00046| name = "Client Name"
00047| address = "123 Street"
00048| 
00049| # Arrays use [[double.brackets]]
00050| [[quote.line_items]]
00051| description = "Item 1"
00052| amount = "$100"
00053| 
00054| [[quote.line_items]]
00055| description = "Item 2"
00056| amount = "$200"
00057| 
00058| # Content blocks - access as data.blocks.* in template
00059| [blocks.description]
00060| title = "Project Description"
00061| format = "markdown"
00062| content = """
00063| Multi-line content with **markdown** supported.
00064| - Bullet points work
00065| - Like this
00066| """
00067| 
00068| [blocks.timeline]
00069| title = "Timeline"
00070| type = "table"
00071| columns = ["Phase", "Duration"]
00072| rows = [
00073|     ["Phase 1", "2 weeks"],
00074|     ["Phase 2", "4 weeks"],
00075| ]
00076| ```
00077| 
00078| ## Template Structure (.typ)
00079| 
00080| **IMPORTANT: Use a single .typ file per template.** Do not split templates into multiple files (e.g., main.typ + template.typ). Keep everything in one self-contained file for simplicity.
00081| 
00082| ### Complete Template Example
00083| 
00084| ```typst
00085| // =============================================================================
00086| // My Template (tmpltr edition)
00087| //
00088| // Usage: tmpltr compile content.toml -o output.pdf
00089| // =============================================================================
00090| 
00091| #import "@local/tmpltr-lib:1.0.0": tmpltr-data, editable, get, brand-color, brand-logo, brand-font
00092| 
00093| // =============================================================================
00094| // HELPER FUNCTIONS (define these before using them)
00095| // =============================================================================
00096| 
00097| #let my-helper(data) = {
00098|   // Helper logic here
00099| }
00100| 
00101| // =============================================================================
00102| // TEMPLATE FUNCTION
00103| // =============================================================================
00104| 
00105| #let my-template(data, doc) = {
00106|   // Brand configuration with safe defaults
00107|   let colors = (
00108|     primary: brand-color(data, "primary", default: "#000000"),
00109|     accent: brand-color(data, "accent", default: "#0066cc"),
00110|     text: brand-color(data, "text", default: "#000000"),
00111|   )
00112|   
00113|   let primary-font = brand-font(data, usage: "body", default: "Arial")
00114|   
00115|   // Page setup
00116|   set page(paper: "a4", margin: 2.5cm)
00117|   set text(font: primary-font, size: 10pt, fill: rgb(colors.text))
00118|   
00119|   // Document content here...
00120|   
00121|   doc
00122| }
00123| 
00124| // =============================================================================
00125| // APPLY TEMPLATE (always at the end)
00126| // =============================================================================
00127| 
00128| #let data = tmpltr-data()
00129| #show: doc => my-template(data, doc)
00130| ```
00131| 
00132| ## Typst Tips and Gotchas
00133| 
00134| ### List Markers (Bullet Points)
00135| 
00136| The default list markers can be too large. Here are options:
00137| 
00138| ```typst
00139| // Option 1: Small symbol with controlled size (RECOMMENDED)
00140| set list(
00141|   marker: text(size: 6pt, baseline: -2pt)[#sym.square.filled],
00142|   indent: 0pt,
00143|   body-indent: 8pt,
00144| )
00145| 
00146| // Option 2: Unicode character (scales with text - may be too large)
00147| set list(marker: [▪])  // U+25AA Black Small Square
00148| 
00149| // Option 3: Fixed-size box (requires manual baseline adjustment)
00150| set list(marker: box(width: 4pt, height: 4pt, fill: black, baseline: 2pt))
00151| ```
00152| 
00153| **Note:** Unicode characters and symbols scale with the surrounding text size. To control bullet size independently, wrap in `text(size: Xpt)[]` or use a `box()`.
00154| 
00155| ### Safe Data Access
00156| 
00157| Always use defaults when accessing data to avoid errors:
00158| 
00159| ```typst
00160| // Using get() helper (recommended)
00161| #get(data, "workshop.title", default: "Untitled")
00162| 
00163| // Using .at() method
00164| #data.at("workshop", default: (:)).at("title", default: "Untitled")
00165| 
00166| // For arrays
00167| #for item in data.at("items", default: ()) [
00168|   #item.at("name", default: "")
00169| ]
00170| ```
00171| 
00172| ### Color Handling
00173| 
00174| Always wrap color strings in `rgb()`:
00175| 
00176| ```typst
00177| // Correct
00178| #text(fill: rgb(colors.primary))[Text]
00179| #line(stroke: 0.5pt + rgb(colors.text))
00180| 
00181| // Wrong - will error
00182| #text(fill: colors.primary)[Text]
00183| ```
00184| 
00185| ### Logo with Fallback
00186| 
00187| ```typst
00188| #let render-logo(data, width) = {
00189|   let logo-path = brand-logo(data, variant: "primary", default: none)
00190|   
00191|   if logo-path != none {
00192|     image(logo-path, width: width)
00193|   } else {
00194|     // Placeholder when no logo
00195|     rect(width: width, height: 1.5cm, stroke: 0.5pt + luma(200))[
00196|       #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: luma(150), size: 9pt)[\[Logo\]]]
00197|     ]
00198|   }
00199| }
00200| ```
00201| 
00202| ### Parsing Lengths from TOML
00203| 
00204| TOML values come as strings, so parse them with `eval()`:
00205| 
00206| ```typst
00207| let logo-width-str = get(data, "brand.logo-width", default: "4cm")
00208| let logo-width = if type(logo-width-str) == str {
00209|   eval(logo-width-str)
00210| } else {
00211|   4cm
00212| }
00213| ```
00214| 
00215| ## Brand Management
00216| 
00217| Brands provide reusable visual identity assets (logos, fonts, colors, contact info).
00218| 
00219| ### Brand Directory Structure
00220| 
00221| ```
00222| $XDG_DATA_HOME/tmpltr/brands/
00223|   byteowlz/
00224|     brand.toml       # Brand configuration
00225|     logos/           # Logo files
00226|       logo.svg
00227|       logo-mono.svg
00228|     fonts/           # Font files
00229|       Inter-Regular.ttf
00230|       Inter-Bold.ttf
00231| ```
00232| 
00233| ### brand.toml Structure
00234| 
00235| ```toml
00236| id = "byteowlz"
00237| default_language = "en"
00238| languages = ["en", "de"]
00239| 
00240| [name]
00241| en = "ByteOwlz"
00242| de = "ByteOwlz GmbH"
00243| 
00244| [colors]
00245| primary = "#0f172a"
00246| secondary = "#64748b"
00247| accent = "#38bdf8"
00248| background = "#ffffff"
00249| text = "#0b1120"
00250| 
00251| [logos]
00252| primary = "logos/logo.svg"
00253| monochrome = "logos/logo-mono.svg"
00254| 
00255| [typography.body]
00256| family = "Inter"
00257| files = ["fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf"]
00258| 
00259| [typography.heading]
00260| family = "Inter"
00261| files = ["fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf"]
00262| 
00263| [contact]
00264| company = { en = "ByteOwlz GmbH" }
00265| email = "hello@byteowlz.com"
00266| website = "https://byteowlz.com"
00267| ```
00268| 
00269| ### Brand CLI Commands
00270| 
00271| ```bash
00272| tmpltr brands list                    # List available brands
00273| tmpltr brands show byteowlz           # Show brand details
00274| tmpltr brands new mybrand             # Create new brand scaffold
00275| tmpltr compile content.toml --brand byteowlz -o output.pdf
00276| ```
00277| 
00278| ## CLI Commands Reference
00279| 
00280| ```bash
00281| # Compile content to PDF
00282| tmpltr compile <content.toml> -o <output.pdf>
00283| tmpltr compile <content.toml> --brand <brand-id> -o <output.pdf>
00284| 
00285| # Watch for changes and recompile
00286| tmpltr watch <content.toml> -o <output.pdf>
00287| 
00288| # Content manipulation
00289| tmpltr get <content.toml> blocks.intro       # Get block content
00290| tmpltr set <content.toml> blocks.intro "New" # Set block content
00291| tmpltr blocks <content.toml>                 # List all blocks
00292| tmpltr validate <content.toml>               # Validate content file
00293| 
00294| # Brand management
00295| tmpltr brands list
00296| tmpltr brands show <brand-id>
00297| tmpltr brands new <brand-id>
00298| 
00299| # Configuration
00300| tmpltr config show
00301| tmpltr config path
00302| ```
00303| 
00304| ## tmpltr-lib Helper Functions
00305| 
00306| The `@local/tmpltr-lib:1.0.0` package provides these helpers:
00307| 
00308| | Function | Description |
00309| |----------|-------------|
00310| | `tmpltr-data()` | Get parsed data from CLI input |
00311| | `get(data, path, default)` | Safely get nested value by dot-path |
00312| | `editable(id, value, type, default)` | Mark editable field |
00313| | `editable-block(id, title, format)[body]` | Mark editable block |
00314| | `md(content)` | Render markdown content |
00315| | `brand-color(data, name, default)` | Get brand color |
00316| | `brand-logo(data, variant, default)` | Get logo path |
00317| | `brand-logo-image(data, variant, width, fallback)` | Render logo image |
00318| | `brand-font(data, usage, default)` | Get font family |
00319| | `brand-contact(data, field, default)` | Get contact info |
00320| 
00321| ## Template Data Access Patterns
00322| 
00323| | Content TOML | Template Access |
00324| |-------------|-----------------|
00325| | `[meta]` | `data.meta` |
00326| | `[quote]` | `get(data, "quote")` |
00327| | `quote.number = "X"` | `get(data, "quote.number")` |
00328| | `[quote.client]` | `get(data, "quote.client")` |
00329| | `[[quote.items]]` | `data.at("quote", default: (:)).at("items", default: ())` |
00330| | `[blocks.intro]` | `get(data, "blocks.intro")` |
00331| | `[brand.colors]` | Use `brand-color()` helper |
00332| 
00333| ## Error Troubleshooting
00334| 
00335| | Error | Cause | Fix |
00336| |-------|-------|-----|
00337| | "File name too long" | Template uses `json()` instead of `json.decode()` | Use `tmpltr-data()` |
00338| | "input file not found" | Wrong template path | Template path is relative to content file |
00339| | "cannot access field" | Missing data | Use `get(data, "path", default: ...)` |
00340| | "unknown variable: tmpltr-data" | Missing import | Add `#import "@local/tmpltr-lib:1.0.0": ...` |
00341| | "brand not found" | Brand doesn't exist | Run `tmpltr brands list` |
00342| 
00343| ## Best Practices
00344| 
00345| 1. **Single file templates**: Keep each template in ONE .typ file. Don't split unnecessarily.
00346| 2. **Use tmpltr-lib**: Import the helper library for cleaner templates
00347| 3. **Use get() for safety**: Always provide defaults for optional fields
00348| 4. **Brands for reusability**: Create brands for company visual identity
00349| 5. **Template paths**: Keep templates in same directory as content
00350| 6. **Control list markers**: Use `text(size: Xpt)[]` wrapper for predictable bullet sizes
00351| 7. **Always wrap colors**: Use `rgb(color-string)` when applying colors
00352| 8. **Parse TOML lengths**: Use `eval()` to convert string lengths like "4cm" to actual lengths
00353|

tmpltr compiles TOML content files into PDFs using Typst templates, with support for brand management (logos, fonts, colors).

## Core Concept

```
[Content File .toml] + [Template .typ] + [Brand (optional)] --> tmpltr compile --> [Output .pdf]
```

The content file contains structured data and text blocks. The template defines layout and styling. Brands provide reusable visual identity assets. tmpltr merges them via Typst.

```bash
# Compile content to PDF
tmpltr compile content.toml -o output.pdf

# Compile with a specific brand
